label: Bible Study
prompt: Wherefore God also hath highly _____ him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verse: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
note: After the humility of the cross comes the exaltation — and a name above every name.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for _____:
verse: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
note: As the new Temple's foundation was laid, old men wept while others shouted for joy — all one sound.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat _____ as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.
verse: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and did eat grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of heaven, till his hairs were grown like eagles' feathers, and his nails like birds' claws.
note: Proud Nebuchadnezzar ate grass like an ox until he learned who really rules — then he praised the King of heaven.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But _____ one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verse: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
note: Daily encouragement as sin's antidote, while it's still 'To day' — a callback to Psalm 95 quoted just before.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of _____ shall come from the presence of the Lord;
verse: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
note: Peter at Solomon's porch, right after the lame man walked: repent, and 'times of refreshing' will come.
